user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my sister. Can you help me validate her WhatsApp number using the Bulk Whatsapp Validator API? Additionally, I need to check the status of her phone number on WhatsApp using the Maytapi WhatsApp API. Finally, provide me with a list of phones registered to my product ID to invite her friends.

TaskList.description: Validate the WhatsApp number of the user's sister using the Bulk Whatsapp Validator API.
Check the status of the validated WhatsApp number using the Maytapi WhatsApp API.
Retrieve a list of phones registered to the user's product ID to invite friends to the birthday party.
